title: A Harder Stretch, No Mile Marker
reflection:
Every pilgrim knows some stretches of road are simply harder — steeper, heavier underfoot — and used to trust the mile markers to say how much further. Your markers have gone unpredictable now; the hard stretch can arrive without warning of how long it lasts.

Walk it anyway, gently. The road doesn't need you to know its length before you're allowed to rest on it.
closing: God of the unmarked road, walk this harder stretch with me. I don't need to see the next marker to trust you're on it too. Amen.

scripture.text: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to a place that he was to receive as an inheritance. And he went out, not knowing where he was going.

title: Setting the Pack Down, Off-Schedule
reflection:
You used to know roughly when you'd need to lighten the pack. Now the need to set something down can arrive on no schedule at all — a heaviness some days, gone the next, back again without pattern.

Set it down whenever it asks to be set down. The road has never required a fixed mile for that kind of honesty.
closing: Show me what to lay down today, on its own timing rather than mine. Let me travel this stretch honestly. Amen.

scripture.text: Come to me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

title: Second Wind, Unannounced
reflection:
Every long-distance walker knows a second wind can arrive without warning — energy returning mid-stride, unbidden, unscheduled. Trust it when it comes, even without the buildup you used to expect.

Use it gently. It doesn't need to explain its timing to be real.
closing: Thank you for this unannounced second wind. Let me use it without demanding it promise to stay. Amen.

scripture.text: He gives power to the faint, and to him who has no might he increases strength.

title: Fog on the Camino
reflection:
Every pilgrim eventually walks through fog — the road ahead unreadable, the next marker invisible, only the ground beneath the next footstep certain.

This waiting was always part of the walk, even on clearer days. It's no less holy now that the fog has no set hour to lift. Keep walking. The ground is still there.
closing: God who walks in fog with me, keep me steady in the unseen stretch. I don't need to see far to trust you're near. Amen.

scripture.text: But they who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles.
